Can be extinguished only by controlling one's own spirituality or the target's below 1/3 of maximum. Flame Envelopment (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): Envelop a weapon with black flames. After landing a successful hit that causes laceration, you may detonate the flames coursing inside the target's veins for 2d6+1 damage (costs 2 SPI). Must be done the next turn or the flames extinguish. Flame Compression (2 SPI): Compress black flames into a dense, cannonball-sized sphere and throw it. Hits with the force of a cannonball, spewing flames on impact. Deals 2d6 damage + burning (1d3 per turn, -1 SPI per turn while burning until target's SPI is under 1/3 max). Range 35 meters, blast radius 10 meters. Freeze — Target (2 SPI): Freeze a target by touch, up to 1 cubic meter. Target rolls HT-1; on failure takes 2d6-1 damage, on success takes half (rounded down). Freeze — Area (3 SPI): Freeze an area up to 10 meter radius centred on self. All targets in range roll HT-1; failure takes 2d6-1 damage, success takes half (rounded down). Ice Wind (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): Icy wind and hail swirl around the Witch (10 meter radius), imposing -3 to all rolls relying on sight and smell. Lasts until dispelled or the Witch runs out of Spirituality. Ice Seal (2 SPI): Seals the target in a cage of layered ice for 1d4 turns. Can be broken with ST-1 roll. Mirror Magic — Hide (1 SPI): Hide in a mirror for 1d6 seconds. If the mirror is destroyed, the Witch is thrown out and takes 2d6 damage. Mirror Magic — Sense (Passive): Sense mirrors within 25 meters. Cursing: Can curse a target if possessing their blood (+2) or a doll made from their flesh and hair (+4). Uses Ritualistic Magic skill. Once the connection is established, the Witch may burn the medium for 2d6 damage, or use it as a base for other rituals (add the medium's bonus to the success rate).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Feather Fall: The glide ratio improves to 3:1 (from 2:3). The Witch may also slow the fall of 1 additional person within 3 m at no extra SPI cost. Shadow Concealment: The Stealth bonus in dim or dark conditions increases to -6 (from -5). When standing still in complete darkness, the Witch is effectively invisible to mundane sight — observers roll Per-4 to notice. Charm: The Instigator's innate Charm improves — the Witch gains +2 to all Influence skill rolls (Diplomacy, Fast-Talk, Sex Appeal) against targets who are attracted to the Witch's gender.

entries.name: Pyromaniac
entries.advantages: DR 2 (fire) resistance to fire damage
entries.ability: Spirit Vision Enhancement: The Pyromaniac's spirit vision is easier to activate and can now perceive the Ether Body of spirits and Beyonders. Danger Intuition Buff: Pre-emptive threat detection is enhanced. Enemies tracking the Pyromaniac suffer -2 to their Tracking rolls. Pyrokinesis: The Pyromaniac can freely control existing flames within a 5-meter radius at no cost (shape, move, intensify, or extinguish). Creating flames from nothing requires Conjure (1 SPI). Each additional 15 meters of range costs 1 SPI. All abilities below are part of Pyrokinesis. Compress (1 SPI): Compresses an existing flame before releasing it. Base damage is 1d6 burning. Each turn spent charging adds +3 damage (max +9, requiring 3 turns of charging). Fire Armour (1 SPI): Wreathes the body in protective flame, granting DR 1 and resistance to cold and poison effects. Lasts until dismissed. Conjure (1 SPI): Conjures a crude flame weapon (improvised weapon stats) that deals burning damage. Lasts 1 minute. Area Burst (2 SPI): Creates a burst of flame in a 3-meter radius. Targets take 1d6+1 burning damage (Dodge to halve). Delay Explosions (2 SPI): Sets a delayed flame trap. 1d6+3 burning damage on detonation (Dodge to halve). Lasts 1 hour or until triggered. Fire Enchant (1 SPI): Enchants a held weapon with flame. The weapon deals +1d6 burning damage for 1 minute. Affects spirits and incorporeal beings normally. Fire Ravens (1 SPI per raven): Conjures 1 flaming raven construct per SPI spent. Each raven has Move 8, HP 2, and deals 1d6-1 burning damage on impact (Dodge to avoid). Ravens disperse after 3 turns. Fire Infusion (1 SPI per hit, free action): When hitting a target with an unarmed strike, infuse it with 1 stack of Fire Infusion. On a subsequent turn, the Pyromaniac may detonate all stacks on a target as a standard action, dealing 1d6 burning damage per stack.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Environment Memory: Range expands to 30 m. The Pyromaniac can replay the last 10 minutes of any fire source's surroundings (from 5 minutes). A successful Survival Knowledge analysis of a burned area reveals the exact cause of ignition and any metaphysical traces left behind. Survival Knowledge: The healing from a successful Survival Knowledge check increases to 1d6+2 HP (from 1d6+1). The Pyromaniac may apply this to self or an ally once per scene without needing to retreat from combat.

entries.name: Warlock
entries.ability: Spell Casting: The Warlock's signature ability. Requires one turn of Concentration to gather Spirituality, then one turn to cast the spell. A material medium or component is required. Artifacts may substitute if the Warlock knows their function. Note: Due to the Law of Beyonder Indestructibility, spell mediums that are main potion ingredients are not exhausted after use. Other ingredients (spirituality-rich items without Beyonder characteristics) are one-time use. Spell Creation System: The Warlock can design new spells using Thaumatology.  The medium must have a concrete mystical connection. Roll Occultism to remember the connection.  Spirituality determines spell strength: 1 SPI for the effect, 2 SPI when strength is needed, 3 SPI for duration.  Roll Thaumatology to design the spell. Results: — Success: Spell works but not flawlessly. SPI cost +2. — Success by 3: Spell works as intended but inefficiently. SPI cost +1. — Success by 5+: Masterfully designed. No cost increase. — Critical Success: Masterpiece. SPI cost -1 (minimum 1 SPI). — Failure: Fail to create the spell. — Critical Failure: The spell WILL backfire. Roll IQ to understand — success means you realize the spell is flawed; failure means you don't.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Eyes of Mystery Prying: The Warlock can now read surface thoughts of sleeping targets and glean dream content without a roll. Against waking targets, the penalty to the target's save increases to -4 (from -3). The Warlock may also learn 1 random weakness or fear of the target (GM discretion) on a successful use. Quick Rituals: The time reduction for known rituals improves to -5 (from -4). The Warlock can perform rituals at half the listed time (minimum 1 minute), and may maintain concentration on one ritual while taking Move-equivalent actions.

entries.name: Appraiser
entries.ability: Appraisal (Passive): The Appraiser examines a Beyonder item, Mystical Item, or Sealed Artifact and instantly identifies its general purpose, dangers, and domain alignment (no roll for common items). For rare or complex items, roll Appraisal — success reveals 1 hidden property, success by 3+ reveals all immediate dangers. This does not bypass active curses or binding, but the Appraiser instinctively knows the safest way to handle the item (which side not to touch, which words not to speak, etc.).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Total Memory: The Appraiser can recall the exact spiritual signature of any item they have appraised, allowing them to identify a disguised or altered version of the same item without a roll. The tactile memory now extends to textures and spiritual resonance, not just shapes. Rapid Analysis: One-quarter time is now one-fifth time (minimum 1 second). The Appraiser may appraise an item instantly (free action) if it is a common type they have seen before.

entries.name: Lucky One
entries.advantages: Lucky One 5 rerolls per session
entries.ability: Passive Luck: At session start, roll 1d6: 1 — Find 1d6 soli. No Passive Luck this session. 2–3 — Luck die = 1d6. 4–5 — Luck die = 1d6+2. 6 — Luck die = 2d6. Once per session, after any 3d6 roll you make, you may subtract your luck die from the total (minimum 3). This can negate a critical failure (17–18).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Foresight: The Lucky One may use Foresight up to 3 times per session (from 2). The GM must warn the Lucky One of any impending danger at least 3 seconds before it occurs (from 2 seconds), giving them a chance to take a defensive action. Premonition: When a Premonition triggers, the Lucky One gains +3 to any single roll made to avoid or mitigate the foreseen event (instead of +2). This bonus may be applied after seeing the roll result.

entries.name: Harvest Priest
entries.advantages: Disease Resistance +3 to HT vs disease and natural toxins
entries.ability: Command Plants (2 SPI): The Harvest Priest exerts authority over plant life and plant-based creatures within 20 meters. Resolve as a Quick Contest of SPI vs the target's Will (for intelligent plant creatures) or a straightforward roll (for mundane plants). Success: the target follows a simple command — entangle, release pollen, part foliage, grow thorns, or hold position — for up to 1 hour. Intelligent plant creatures may attempt a new Will roll each minute to break free. If the command harms the target or its allies, the target gets +3 to resist. Weather Rituals (Ritualistic Magic): Upon drinking the potion, the Harvest Priest obtains several Ritualistic Spells focused on manipulating the weather within a certain area. All are cast using Ritualistic Magic and cost SPI as noted. Clear Skies (2 SPI): Clears clouds, fog, and precipitation in a 200-meter radius over 1d6 minutes. Works against natural weather only; supernatural weather effects resist with a Quick Contest of the caster's Ritualistic Magic vs the effect's source. Summon Rain (2 SPI): Conjures steady rain in a 200-meter radius. Takes effect over 1d6 minutes. Can end droughts, water crops, or create cover. Does not produce lightning or storms. Calm Winds (1 SPI): Reduces wind speed in a 100-meter radius. Strong gales become breezes; hurricane-force drops to strong wind. Lasts 10 minutes. Nature's Bounty (1 SPI): Accelerates plant growth in a 5-meter radius. Crops, herbs, and medicinal plants mature in 1 minute. Produces enough food for 2 people per casting. Does not affect magical or spiritually-altered flora. Restorative Harvest (2 SPI): Touches a living plant and draws on its life force to heal the Priest or an ally for 1d HP. The plant wilts visibly for 24 hours and cannot be used again during that time. Spirit Vision (Nature): The Harvest Priest's Spirit Vision reads the health and spiritual state of natural life. Costs 1 SPI per minute. While active, senses disease, corruption, and unnatural influences within 100 meters.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Farming Tools: The Harvest Priest can use any farming or gardening tool as a weapon at no default penalty, and the bonus to tool-based attacks increases to +5 (from +4). The tool counts as a Beyonder weapon of the Priest's Sequence for harming spiritual entities. Physician: The +3 bonus to Physician checks now applies to diagnosing and treating supernatural ailments (spiritual contamination, Beyonder-induced illnesses, curses with biological symptoms). The healing time for natural diseases under the Harvest Priest's care is halved. Potion Brewing: The -1 penalty for brewing Potions without a proper lab is eliminated entirely when working with natural ingredients (herbs, plants, mineral salts). Brewing time for healing potions is reduced by half.

entries.name: Vampire

skills.name: Hidden Lore (Darkness, Shadow and Moon domains)

entries.advantages: Spirituality Absorption when feasting on spiritually rich blood, restore SPI
entries.drawbacks: Vampire Diet can only drink spiritually rich blood Sun Allergy extreme discomfort under direct sunlight Purification Weakness 2d6 damage if targeted by purification Slow-beating Heart piercing/stake attacks to the heart deal ×2 damage
entries.ability: Wings of Flight (1 SPI): Gain +2 Basic Move for flight for 1 minute. Extended flight costs 1 SPI per additional minute. Bat Swarm Form (3 SPI): Transform into a swarm of illusory bats for 1 minute. In this form you are immune to physical damage from non-magical weapons. You may emit black gases that poison a target for 1d6 damage over 2 turns (HT roll to resist), or create black flames that deal 1d6 burn per turn for 4 turns. Cannot use other abilities while in swarm form. Corrosive Claw (2 SPI): An innate melee attack (Brawling skill). Counts as a knife for damage purposes (thr-1 cut / sw-2 imp). Ignores natural DR — skin, hide, fur, scales, chitin, and membrane — but not manufactured armour or magical DR. Abyss Shackles (2 SPI): A spell belonging to the Darkness domain that condenses nearby shadow and darkness into tangible shackles to restrict and control the enemy. Roll Ritualistic Magic vs the target's HT. On success, the target is bound for 3 turns. The target may attempt to break free with a ST-3 roll each turn. If the caster's concentration is broken, the shackles dissolve immediately. The Embrace (7 SPI): When a Vampire has fully digested their current Sequence and possesses at least 1 surplus Beyonder characteristic (representing excess essence beyond what their own advancement requires), they may bestow it upon a willing or helpless human through a 1-hour ritual. The target rises as a Sequence 7 Vampire after 1d3 hours. The Vampire permanently loses 1 max SPI per use until they consume and digest additional potion material to replenish the lost characteristic. Blood Servant Conversion (3 SPI): A spell that a Vampire can use to turn a willing or helpless living creature into a blood servant. Roll Ritualistic Magic. On success, the target becomes a blood servant: they cannot disobey a direct order from the Vampire, all mundane illnesses are cured, and they permanently gain +2 HT and +2 HP. The bond lasts until the blood servant dies or the Vampire voluntarily releases them. Failure: SPI is spent, no effect. Critical Failure: the target becomes hostile and gains +2 to all actions against the Vampire for 24 hours.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Spirit Vision (Animals): The Vampire's animal Spirit Vision range expands to 80 m (from 50 m). The Vampire can read an animal's emotional state, recent memories (last 24 hours), and whether it has been spiritually tampered with. Beast Taming: The Vampire can now control up to 3 animals simultaneously (from 2) and may issue complex multi-step commands. Animals under the Vampire's control gain +2 to ST and +1 Basic Speed. Physician (Animal): The +3 Physician bonus now applies to the Vampire's own natural healing processes — recover +1 extra HP per day of rest. The Vampire may also use Physician to diagnose spiritual ailments in animals and moon-aligned creatures without penalty.

entries.name: Serial Killer
entries.ability: Interference (Ritual): The Serial Killer may sacrifice a living being in a 1-hour ritual to shroud themselves in sacrificial residue. Animal sacrifice: Divination and Spirit Channeling targeting the Serial Killer are at -2 for 1d6 days. Human sacrifice: -4 for 1d6 days. Devil Worship (Ritual): Requires a unique serial killing spree (minimum 3 murders) without being caught. Once all cases are officially closed, the Serial Killer may perform a ritual (standard ritual rules) to summon a Devil projection. Roll 3d6 + modifiers vs Ritualistic Magic — lower roll = more favorable outcome. The GM determines the Devil's ST, IQ, and Favourability (roll 3d6 for each if desired; lower = better on all three). Failure: ritual fails; the killing spree must be repeated from scratch.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Enhance Improvised Weapons: The Serial Killer's improvised weapon skill increases to Brawling+3 (from Brawling+2). The weapon counts as a Beyonder weapon of the Serial Killer's Sequence, and on a critical hit, the improvised weapon breaks in a way that deals an additional 1d6 corrosion damage. Firearms Proficiency: The DX bonus increases to +2 (from +1). The Serial Killer may fire two shots as a single Attack maneuver without the usual dual-wield penalties, provided both shots target the same enemy. Poison Enhancement: The +2 bonus to poison-crafting rolls now applies to identifying and creating supernatural toxins (spiritual venom, corrupted elixirs). The Serial Killer's poisons also affect spirits and incorporeal beings at half potency (round down).

entries.name: Werewolf
entries.advantages: DR 2 (all) physical toughness even outside transformation Regeneration (fast) recover 1 HP per minute while in Full Transformation only Night Vision 9 see clearly in near-total darkness; no penalties in moonlight or starlight
entries.drawbacks: Sun Vulnerability Sun-domain abilities deal double damage and ignore DR entirely; regeneration suspended for 1 minute after a Sun-domain hit Full Moon Curse Every full moon roll Will-3 or enter uncontrolled semi-transformed state; consistent failures accumulate toward permanent personality change
entries.ability: Partial Transformation (1 SPI per feature): Manifest individual werewolf features — claws, venom, or enhanced speed — without full transformation. Each feature costs 1 SPI and lasts the scene. Full Transformation (1 SPI): Ready maneuver to transform completely. Lasts 1 minute (extend at 1 SPI per minute). While transformed:  ST +3, DX +2 (adds to base potion stats)  Claws: sw+2 cut; Bite: thr+2 imp. Both count as Beyonder weapons of the Werewolf's Sequence  Venom: on a hit that breaks skin, target rolls HT-2 each round for 1d rounds or suffers -2 to all physical rolls. Failure by 5+ causes partial muscle control loss for 1d minutes  Speed: +1 Basic Move (stacks with base potion bonus for +2 total). Opponents roll Per-2 to track position at full speed  Regeneration (Fast): 1 HP per minute. Sun-domain damage heals at normal rate Weakness — Sun Vulnerability: Sun-domain abilities deal double damage and ignore DR entirely. Regeneration suspended for 1 minute after a Sun-domain hit. Werewolf Kin (1 SPI): When a target has failed its HT roll against venom, spend 1 SPI and make a Quick Contest of SPI vs the target's Will. On success, the target becomes a puppet Werewolf for 1d hours — ST 14, DX 10, claws only, no special abilities. Collapses and reverts at duration's end or at 0 HP. Dark Horror (1 SPI): Free action. Deepens darkness within 10 meters — faint light sources extinguished, moonlight banished. Targets roll Will or suffer -2 to rational thought and movement for 1d rounds. Fail by 5+ — paralyzed with dread for one round. Strong light sources reduce radius to 5 meters. Sun-domain holy light negates entirely. Repel Light (Free): Free action. Pushes back faint illumination — candles, distant gas lamps, ambient moonlight — within 5 meters. No effect against strong or supernatural light. Primarily maintains darkness during Dark Horror. Anti-Divination (Passive): Any divination or Spirit Vision targeting the Werewolf reveals only a figure covered in black hair regardless of transformation state. True identity, Sequence, pathway, emotional state, and location cannot be read through any spiritual means. Higher-Sequence Beyonders (Seq 5+) may bypass this with a Quick Contest of SPI vs the Werewolf's SPI. Werewolf's Curse — Full Moon: Every full moon roll Will-3 or enter uncontrolled semi-transformed state — predatory, bloodlust-driven, aware but unable to fully suppress. Consistent failures accumulate as narrative disadvantage toward permanent personality change and loss of humanity. Certain Sealed Artifacts corresponding to the Scarlet Scholar allow rationality to be maintained during full moon. Acquiring one is a significant campaign goal. Lunatic's Curse — Retained: All corruption thresholds remain reduced by 2. Full moon curse stacks with existing instability.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Improvised Weapons Expertise: The Werewolf's improvised weapon damage bonus increases to +2 (from +1). Any object used as a weapon also counts as a Beyonder weapon of the Werewolf's Sequence, and on a successful hit, the target must roll HT or be Shaken (see GURPS p. B360) for 1 turn. Escape Artist: The Werewolf may attempt to escape supernatural bonds (magical restraints, spirit chains, shadow shackles) at full Escape skill with +2. Against mundane restraints, escape is automatic unless the restraints are specifically designed to hold a supernatural creature. Hidden Exits Sense: Range expands to 30 m (from 20 m). The Werewolf can sense hidden exits even when they are magically concealed — the ability pierces concealment up to Seq 7 level.

entries.name: Interrogator
entries.ability: Illusory Torture Devices (1 SPI): An Interrogator can shape their spirituality into any kind of torture device. The device must be held, or it ceases to exist. The device deals spirit body damage (see Chapter 5) as a small weapon (Knife): thr-1 cut / sw-2 imp. Psychic Lashing (2 SPI): Coats a held object with illusory lightning for 1 minute. Attacks deal +2 spirit body damage (see Chapter 5) in addition to normal damage. Melee range. Psychic Piercing (1 SPI): Range 5 meters. Target rolls HT or is mentally Stunned for 1 turn (see GURPS stun rules, p. B420: -4 to active defenses, may attempt HT each turn to recover). Deals 2d6-3 spirit body damage (see Chapter 5). Whip of Pain (1 SPI): Deals continuous 1d6-3 spirit body damage per turn and costs 1 SPI each turn to maintain. Target must roll HT or be mentally Stunned for 1 turn (GURPS stun rules, p. B420). On subsequent turns, the target may roll Will to recover from the stun.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Authority: The Will penalty for targets within the Interrogator's Jurisdiction increases to -4 (from -2). The Interrogator may also project Authority as a free action once per scene, causing all hostile NPCs within 10 m to hesitate for 1 turn (no actions except active defenses). This does not affect PCs or major NPCs. Jurisdiction: The Interrogator's knowledge of local laws, procedures, and loopholes now extends to neighbouring jurisdictions. Rote legal knowledge is automatic — no roll needed. For obscure or hidden regulations, the IQ bonus increases to +4 (from +2).

entries.name: Briber
entries.ability: Bribery (1 SPI): All Bribe effects cost 1 SPI each to activate. By offering the target a symbolic or material bribe, you impose one of four effects on them. The bribe does not need to be willingly accepted — throwing an object counts as a valid bribe as long as the target interacts with it or is simply near it. Make a DX roll (or Throwing skill, if known) to land the bribe. If the bribe is thrown and misses: a margin of failure of 1–2 still counts, but duration becomes halved. Diminishing Rule (applies to all Bribe effects): At the end of each turn, the penalty/bonus decreases by 1. Once it reaches 0, the effect ends. Weaken: Target suffers -4 to attack and defense rolls (drops -1/turn, lasts 4 turns). Charm (1 SPI): Target rolls Will at -3 each turn (drops -1/turn, 3 turns max). Failure: target will not attack the briber that turn. Critical Failure: target lashes out at self or allies. Arrogance (1 SPI): Target rolls IQ at -2 each turn (drops -1/turn, 2 turns max). Failure: target makes a reckless or stupid action (GM discretion). Critical Failure: target loses their turn. Connection (1 SPI): Mystical link to target. You gain +2 to Divination and Tracking rolls against them (drops -1/turn, 2 turns max).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Eloquence: When using Eloquence through Intimidation, the target's Will penalty increases to -5 (from -3). The Briber may also use Eloquence through Diplomacy or Fast-Talk (choose one per scene) with a -2 penalty to the target's save instead of -5. Intimidation: The Intimidation skill bonus from Barbarian increases by +2 (total +4 from all sources). If the Briber successfully Intimidates a target, the next Bribery attempt against that target in the same scene has its SPI cost reduced by 1 (minimum 1 SPI).

entries.name: Faceless
entries.ability: Shapeshifting: The Faceless can freely mould their body and flesh, enabling them to perfectly mimic their target's face, body, voice, and even smell to some degree. It is not possible for a Faceless to change their gender. Their new height cannot be more than a head taller or shorter than their original height (15/20 cm). They can make their face completely featureless, without any eyes, nose, or mouth. They can change their body odour by adjusting the pores on their skin. To successfully impersonate someone in front of a person who knows the person being impersonated, the Faceless must succeed an Acting roll, or the person will grow suspicious. Not knowing the person being impersonated well causes a -3 penalty to the roll. Identity Confusion (2 SPI): The Faceless can mask their spiritual aura to match a different person they have studied or touched. If a divination targets the Faceless's original identity, it instead picks up the masked aura — leading the diviner to the wrong person. Duration: 1 hour, or until the Faceless changes their masked identity. The Faceless must have met or studied the target whose aura they mimic — a simple description is not enough; 10+ minutes of close observation or a personal item is required. A diviner who critically succeeds on their Divination Arts or Ritualistic Magic roll realises the spiritual signature is a mask and may attempt a Quick Contest of Divination Arts or Ritualistic Magic vs the Faceless's SPI to pierce it.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Flaming Jump (1 SPI): Range increased to 40 m. Flame Controlling (1 SPI): Range increased to 40 m. Illusion Creation (1 SPI): Range increased to 26 m. Air Bullet (1 SPI): Damage increased to 2d+2 pi (range 20/40).

entries.name: Baron of Corruption
entries.ability: Distortion (3 SPI): The Baron of Corruption can use the loopholes found in Order. By distorting the target's words, actions, and intent, they can formulate a certain Order that provides them with an advantage, restraining and influencing their opponent. They can distort the direction and target of attacks. They can Seal ordinary rooms or Unseal confined spaces. The extent to which they can distort the direction and target of attacks is at the GM's discretion. Corrosion (2 SPI): The Baron of Corruption can turn the hearts of people within 10 metres dark and greedy, making them make irrational choices.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Bribery — All Effects: The Briber's Weaken penalty increases to -6 (from -4). Charm's Will penalty increases to -5 (from -3). Connection's bonus increases to +4 (from +2). The Diminishing Rule still applies. Eloquence: The Baron of Corruption may use Eloquence as a free action once per scene to impose the Arrogance effect on a target within 10 m without spending SPI. The target rolls IQ-2 as usual.

entries.name: Judge
entries.advantages: Ancient Hermes Fluent — can speak, read, and write this dead mystical language
entries.ability: Prohibition (2 SPI): Speak in Ancient Hermes to forbid certain actions or Beyonder powers within a 10-meter radius — no contest required. Format: "'X' is Prohibited here". Examples: Flight, Teleportation, Invisibility. Violators suffer -12 to all rolls involving the prohibited action. Targets with SPI higher than the Judge's suffer -6 instead. Cannot kill specific individuals — suppresses or repels them instead. Suppressed if the target is 3+ Sequences above the Judge. Imprison (2 SPI): Range: LOS, up to 15 m. Freezes one target in place. Breaking free requires ST-4 or Escape-4 each turn. Roots Spirit Body-type creatures, but cannot prevent escape via Substitution abilities. Declare "Release" to end early. Confinement (2 SPI): Range: LOS, up to 10 m. Area variant of Imprison — immaterial cell around a designated area, impenetrable by Spirit Bodies. Circumvents Substitution — targets reappear within boundaries. Can seal a room against entry or exit. Maintain Secrecy (1 SPI): Eye contact. Quick Contest: Judge's SPI vs. target's Will. On failure, the target cannot voluntarily reveal the Judge's secrets or disobey a simple instruction for 1 hour, and must actively conceal them. Mind-affecting compulsion. May release early. Death (3 SPI): Declare target Dead, then charge. Roll Brawling or DX to hit. Deals swing crushing damage × hit location wounding multiplier (e.g., skull ×4, vitals ×3). Flog (1 SPI): Swing hand to strike with an invisible whip. Roll Brawling +2 or DX +2 to hit. Deals 2d+3 cutting; ignores 1 DR. Invisible — unaware targets cannot defend unless they suspect attack. Exile (X SPI): Speak "Exile" to blast the target away. Per SPI spent (1-5), hurl target 20 meters in a chosen direction. Target rolls HT-4 to halve distance. Affects Spirit Bodies. Collision deals 1d crushing per 10 meters travelled (or fraction).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Authority: Still costs 1 SPI to activate for the scene. Aura forces anyone meeting the Judge's eyes to roll Will or suffer -1 to attack rolls against the Judge for that turn. Can subtly influence environment within 10 m (still air, dim lights, quiet sounds). Authority's -1 penalty applies to all hostile actions within earshot that violate the Judge's stated rules. Jurisdiction: Maximum range approaches the size of Backlund. While inside Jurisdiction, the Judge gains +2 to Law, Intimidation, and Administration rolls.

entries.name: Polymath
entries.advantages: Jack-of-all-trade Reduce study time by half
entries.ability: Analysis (1 SPI): Roll Thaumatology to analyze a Beyonder power used by an opponent. Bonuses by target Sequence: +3 (Seq 9), +2 (Seq 8), +1 (Seq 7), +0 (Seq 6), -3 (Seq 5), -8 (Seq 4). Success reveals the exact details of the ability. Failure wastes the SPI — no information gained. Imitation (2 SPI): After a successful Analysis, imitate the analyzed power. Roll Thaumatology. Bonus based on Analysis margin of success:  +0 (by 0-2) → 20% efficiency  +2 (by 3-5) → 35% efficiency  +4 (by 6+) → 50% efficiency  +6 (crit) → 50% efficiency (Seq 4 powers do not receive the crit bonus) Damage abilities deal half damage at all efficiency levels. Non-damage abilities have range or effect reduced proportionally. Can imitate passive powers (Danger Premonition, Fate powers) and active powers (Recording). Cannot imitate Authorities at any Sequence.

entries.name: Wind-blessed
entries.drawbacks: Irascible GM may remind the player to roleplay irritability matching a gale. Refusing to act irascible when appropriate may incur a penalty at GM discretion.
entries.ability: Wind Control (3 SPI): Surround yourself with howling winds for 1 minute. Ranged attacks against you suffer -4 to hit. Melee attackers within 2 m must roll ST or be pushed back 1d m. Windblades (3 SPI): Create invisible sharp wind blades at range. Roll Throwing or DX to hit. Deals 3d+3 cutting. Range 20/40 m. Target may dodge. Flight (1 SPI): Fly at Basic Move ×1.5, max altitude 10 m. Duration 1 minute (extend at 1 SPI/min). Floating Wind (1 SPI): Hover in place up to 1 m off the ground for 1 minute. Wind Footing (1 SPI): Generate wind beneath feet — Move ×2 for 1 minute. Glide (1 SPI): Glide at normal Move, losing 1 m altitude per 3 m forward. Functions even if Flight is Prohibited by a Judge. Wind Fist (1 SPI): Imbue fists with spiraling wind for 1 minute. Unarmed strikes deal +1d crushing damage. Wind Manipulation (1 SPI): Use wind to carry small objects (up to 1 kg) to your hand within 10 m. Also eavesdrop on conversations within 20 m via wind vibrations. Duration 1 minute. Wind Cushion (X SPI): Reactive. When you would take damage, spend SPI to create an air cushion. Gain DR 3 per SPI spent against that single instance. Decide before damage is rolled. Water Control (X SPI): Manipulate and shape water within 10 m. 1 SPI for simple shapes or moving water; 2 SPI for complex manipulation (GM discretion). Deep Dive (Passive): Dive to 100 m depth without pressure penalties. Float (1 SPI): Float on water without sinking for 10 minutes. Night Vision (Passive): See clearly in darkness up to normal vision range.

entries.name: Prometheus
entries.ability: Mental Fortitude (Passive): The Prometheus has hardened their mind against mental corruption. Reduce any CoR gained from purely mental sources (psychic attacks, madness-inducing effects, mental influence, and similar effects) by 3 (minimum 0). This does not protect against physical or spiritual corruption. Superior Observation (Passive): The Prometheus can directly sense where valuable items are within a 50-meter range, their approximate value, and possible types. Unless there are Beyonder powers of Concealment that can resist this type of perception, no treasure can escape a Prometheus' nose. Steal (1+ SPI): The Prometheus can steal many things within a 50 m radius. Steal Beyonder Power (2 SPI): Choose a target and a specific Beyonder power you have witnessed them use. Roll Thaumatology with modifiers:  +4 per Sequence below the Prometheus  -4 per Sequence above the Prometheus  +2 if you have studied or witnessed the target's power multiple times  -2 if the power is poorly understood or unfamiliar Success: you steal that power and may use it freely for the next 10 minutes at its full potency. The target loses access to the power for at least 12 hours. A power already activated before the theft continues functioning normally. Steal Object (1 SPI): Roll Sleight of Hand to covertly steal a visible object from a target within 50 m (a held item, worn necklace, pocketed key) or to slip a held object into a target's pocket or hand within the same range. Resisted by the target's Per if they might notice, or by an opposed Sleight of Hand roll if they are alert. Steal Fire (1 SPI): Steal flame itself — extinguish any non-magical fire within 50 m immediately. Magical fire (Beyonder flames) requires a Thaumatology roll at -2 to extinguish.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Decryption: Decryption now requires only 1 minute of concentration (instead of the usual time) for mundane subjects, and 5 minutes for mystical subjects. The Prometheus automatically receives at least a Standard fact on any successful roll. Beyonder Knowledge: By handling a mystical item or ritual component for 1 turn, the Prometheus intuitively senses its general purpose and relative danger — no roll required. Superior Observation: The Cryptologist's trained observation range expands to 50 m, now matching the Prometheus's innate range. The Prometheus can sense whether a concealed target within range is a Beyonder, though not their specific Sequence or pathway. Detect Lies and Body Language rolls gain +4 (from +3). Mental Disruption: The Will penalty increases to -5. The Prometheus may target up to 3 individuals simultaneously by spending 3 SPI total. Reminder / Theft: Reminder distance increases to 15 m. The Prometheus can now steal spiritual materials that are actively in use by a target (e.g., a talisman being held ready for casting) by winning a Quick Contest of Thaumatology vs. the target's Will.

entries.name: Scribe
entries.ability: Record (1 SPI): After witnessing an active Beyonder power being used, roll 3d6 against the target below based on the power's origin Sequence. Success stores one use of that power; failure wastes the SPI. Only active (not passive) powers can be Recorded. Record target (roll 3d6 ≤ target): Seq 7-9: 15 | Seq 6: 11 | Seq 5: 9 | Seq 4: 5 (cannot succeed even after 10 attempts) Storage slots: 1 Demigod-level power (2 after full digestion), 8 Seq 5-6 powers, 20 Seq 7-9 powers. If a Seq 7 power is demonstrated by a Seq 5 Beyonder and stored in a Seq 7 slot, it manifests at Seq 6 level.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Crystal Ball Focus: When using a crystal ball for divination, the bonus to Ritualistic Magic rolls increases to +4 (from +2). The Scribe may also use a crystal ball to Record a power seen within the ball's reflection, as long as the power was demonstrated within the past 24 hours. Interference: The SPI contest for anti-divination gains +3 in the Scribe's favour. The Scribe may extend Interference to cover a 10 m radius around themselves for 2 SPI, protecting all allies within. Door Opening / Peephole: Door Opening can now bring up to 5 people through a spatial obstacle. Peephole thickness limit increases to 2 m.

entries.name: Demoness of Pleasure
entries.advantages: Charisma +1 +1 to reaction rolls and Influence skills Throat Control cannot be easily choked — immune to chokeholds and neck-crushing techniques Greater Acute Vision +4 to all vision-based Perception rolls; allows the Pleasure to see their own Spider's Threads Appearance (Very Beautiful) +3 to social reaction rolls
entries.ability: Spider's Threads: The Pleasure can spread spider-like, almost invisible silk threads from her hair that can be used for various purposes. Basic Spider Threads Trap (1 SPI / free outside battle): The Pleasure places her threads to create a detection mechanism. She can easily detect when her silk is destroyed. In battle, this reveals the enemy's size, relative strength, and speed. Noticing the threads requires a Per roll at -5. Threads Cocoon (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure rapidly spins a cocoon of threads around herself as a protective barrier. She recovers +1 HP/turn (at the start of her turn) while inside. The cocoon possesses the Pleasure's maximum SPI in HP. When the cocoon is destroyed, remaining damage is transferred to the Pleasure (e.g., if the cocoon has 4 HP remaining and an attack deals 7 damage, the cocoon is destroyed and the Pleasure takes the remaining 3 HP of damage). Pleasure Shock (2 SPI): If the enemy has made contact with the Pleasure's threads, she can cause them to experience "true pleasure" — spasms and loss of bodily control. The target must roll Will -4; on failure they lose control of their body for 1d turns. Thread Entanglement (2 SPI): The Pleasure shoots out a mass of threads that restrain her enemy. Breaking free requires a ST -4 or Escape -3 roll. Charm (Passive): The Pleasure's beauty and charm are significantly enhanced. Any man who comes into contact with her must roll Will -2 or be charmed. The longer someone is in her presence, the harder the Will roll becomes to break free from infatuation (GM's discretion). This also affects homosexual men and, to a lesser degree, women. The Pleasure may hide her beauty by using the Disguise skill at -2 to negate this effect. Dark Magic: The Pleasure's dark magic is enhanced. Cleansing Black Flame (1 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure ignites a silent black flame within her body to cleanse curses, negative influences, or purge ghosts/wraiths. Wraiths inside her take 2d+1 damage per turn. Spirit Body Trap (4 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure encases a spiritual creature in layers of frost and black fire to contain it. The spiritual creature must roll SPI -5 to break out. Black Flame Bullets (1 SPI per 2 bullets): The Pleasure creates up to 7 black flames around her and launches them at opponents. Roll Thaumatology to hit. Each bullet deals 2d damage and then ignites the target for 1d damage/turn while burning. Burning persists until the target's SPI drops below 1/3 max (rounded down) or the flames are extinguished. Ice Barrier (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure encases herself or an ally within reach in an ice barrier. The barrier has SPI + 4 HP. After destruction, remaining damage is negated. Ice Spear (3 SPI): The Pleasure conjures a spear of pure ice that pierces mystical defences. Roll Thaumatology to hit. On impact, deals 5d+2 damage. Mirror Magic: The Pleasure can cast her curses on an enemy if she manages to reflect the enemy's entire figure in a mirror. Mirror and Stave Substitution (3 SPI): The Pleasure's mirror substitution can now be performed up to twice per turn and heals her for +1 HP and +1 FP.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Black Flames: The Pleasure's black flames deal +2 damage per die (minimum +1) against spirit bodies. Flames can now be extinguished only by reducing the target's SPI below 1/4 of maximum (from 1/3). Flame Compression: Damage increases to 3d6 (from 2d6). Blast radius expands to 15 m (from 10 m). The compressed sphere may also be split into 2 smaller spheres (1d6+2 each) targeting separate enemies. Freeze — Target: HT penalty increases to -3 (from -1). Damage increases to 3d6-1 (from 2d6-1). May freeze up to 2 cubic meters. Mirror Magic — Hide: Duration increases to 1 minute (from 1d6 seconds). If the mirror is destroyed, the Pleasure takes only 1d6 damage (from 2d6).

entries.name: Scrolls Professor
entries.ability: Scroll Making (1+ SPI): The Scrolls Professor can create magical scrolls from various materials. The Warlock's Spell Creation system is upgraded — any spell the Professor has designed or learned can be inscribed into a scroll for instant later use. Creating a Scroll: Roll Alchemy to prepare the material (parchment, ink, or leather infused with spiritual components), then roll Thaumatology to inscribe the spell's mystical pattern. Failure on either roll simply wastes the materials — the scroll is not created but no SPI is lost. Additional scroll types may be created with GM approval. Using a Scroll: On a later turn, recite the corresponding incantation as a Ready maneuver. The scroll burns and releases its stored ability immediately — no concentration or casting time required. The SPI cost was paid at creation time; the user only needs a free hand to hold and activate the scroll. Some of the Scroll Spells the Scrolls Professor can create include: Secret Voice: Forms a channel linking 3 to 5 people within 50 meters, allowing communication without obstruction. Lasts 10 minutes. Freezing: Creates a stream of crystal clear light that freezes the target. The target suffers -3 to all rolls, and halves Basic Move and Dodge for 1d6 turns. If a second Freezing scroll is used on the same target within 1 minute, the target is sealed in ice — break free with ST-3. Storm: Creates a wide thunderstorm centred on the user. Deals 3d6 damage to all in a 10 m radius. Half damage on HT-2 save. Numb: Releases a light green luster that paralyzes a single target within 20 m. The target is Stunned and may resist with Will-3 at the start of each turn. Burning: Releases flames that engulf a 5 m radius. Deals 1d6 burning damage, plus 1d6 per turn for 1d3 turns unless the target uses an action to extinguish the flames. Wind: A swift wind envelops a selected target within 20 m, doubling their Basic Move and granting +3 to Dodge for 1 minute. Healing: Releases a green light that heals all allies within a 10 m radius for 1d6 HP. Sun: Releases a holy light aura in a 10 m radius. Deals 3d6 damage to undead and evil creatures. No effect on living creatures.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Eyes of Mystery Prying: The Scrolls Professor can read the contents of any written mystical text (scrolls, grimoires, encrypted notes) by touch alone — no roll required. The passive penalty to Dream/Illusion rolls against the Professor increases to -5. Quick Rituals: The time reduction for known rituals improves to -6 (from -5). The Professor can perform rituals at 1/3 the listed time (minimum 1 minute), and may maintain concentration on one ritual while taking Attack or All-Out Defense actions. Spirit Contract: Maximum simultaneous contracts increases to 8 (from 4). The Professor may now inscribe a Spirit Contract onto a scroll — anyone who reads and activates the scroll is bound by the contract's terms as if they had negotiated it themselves.

entries.name: Artisan
entries.ability: Manufacturing (1 SPI): The Artisan is an undisputed master of creation. To craft a Sealed Artifact, the Artisan first makes a crafting skill roll (Smith, Jeweler, Machinist, etc.) to manufacture the item from the Beyonder Characteristic, then rolls Thaumatology with a bonus equal to the margin of success from the crafting roll. The Sealed Artifact gains better effects and fewer negative side effects depending on how well the Thaumatology roll succeeds. If the Characteristic is from a higher or lower Sequence, apply ±2 to the Thaumatology roll per Sequence difference. Failing the Thaumatology roll means reduced power and increased drawbacks — the item is still created but flawed. To create a Mystical Item (without a Beyonder Characteristic), the Artisan follows the same process. The item's longevity depends on success margin: 0–2 = 6 months, 3–5 = 1 year, 6–8 = 2 years, Critical Success = 3 years. The Artisan can also fix Spirit World summoning rituals (such as Messenger contracts) directly into an item — anyone who possesses the item may activate the summoning without knowing the ritual.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Appraisal: The Artisan's Appraisal sense is now reflexive. They may identify a Beyonder item's purpose, dangers, and domain alignment as a free action. For rare or complex items, roll Appraisal — on success, all immediate dangers are revealed (not just one). Items lower than the Artisan's own Sequence are identified automatically. Rapid Manufacturing: The Artisan may reduce the manufacturing time for crafting by half. For items of the Artisan's own Sequence or lower, they may attempt to craft a rushed version in 1/4 the normal time (minimum 1 hour), taking -3 to the crafting roll.

entries.name: Hypnotist
entries.advantages: DR +3 Dragon Scales — draconic scales beneath the skin provide DR 3 against all physical damage
entries.ability: Psychological Invisibility (Free, No SPI Cost): The Hypnotist can remain in the blind spot of one's consciousness. This works even against Spirit Vision and a Hunter's Danger Intuition (until the user prepares to strike). The target will not perceive the user even when standing right before them. Strong interactions with the surroundings can break the invisibility. At this Sequence, can only work on one target at a time.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Hypnosis: Psychological Cue undergoes a qualitative change, becoming Hypnosis. Non-Combat Hypnosis (2 SPI): Open the door and enter the target's Body of Heart and Mind. The target rolls Will-6 to resist. The target will not notice they are following the Hypnotist's arrangements. Cannot directly harm the target's life. Battle Hypnotism (2 SPI): Forcefully hypnotize an enemy mid-combat. The target rolls Will-6 to resist. Lasts 1 turn. The Hypnotist can make the target perform an action that does not threaten their own life.

entries.name: Notary
entries.advantages: DR 1 Fire/Light — resistance to fire and light-based attacks
entries.ability: Notarization: By utilizing a language that stirs the powers of nature along with the relevant words, a Notary can achieve Authentication, Amplification, or Nullification. Authentication (1 SPI): Determine the authenticity of various things such as potion formulas, and enforce Contracts. Once a signature is provided as confirmation, even a Sequence 5 Beyonder cannot violate it, and a Sequence 4 Demigod would have great difficulty. Those who lie or break the Contract are engulfed in burning golden flames, suffering 15d damage. Amplification (2 SPI): A valid Notarization temporarily enhances a targeted Beyonder power. Proclaim "God says it's effective!" The effect depends on the GM. Nullification (2 SPI): An invalid Notarization weakens or forcefully disperses a targeted Beyonder power. Proclaim "God says it's ineffective!" Powers of all kinds, including verbal command abilities, authorities, and traits can be affected.

entries.name: Rose Bishop
entries.ability: Flesh & Blood Magic (Passive): A Rose Bishop can stack up to 50 Stacks of Flesh and Blood; 1 Stack equals 1 HP. They can use Stacks as a free action to regenerate. A Rose Bishop must regularly replenish their Flesh and Blood. If they have less than 10 Stacks, they double any corruption they would take. They can use the Flesh and Blood of corpses in their immediate surroundings. A corpse equals 25 Flesh and Blood Stacks. Flesh Cloak (X Flesh and Blood): Create cloaks of sticky Flesh that resist magic and reduce damage. The cloak has 1 HP per Flesh used and DR 3 against Beyonder Powers. Flesh Blood Fusion (0 Flesh and Blood): Melt into pure sticky Flesh and Blood that can penetrate the ground and move. Halves all damage except large-area damage (which deals double). Can hide inside a host's stomach — the host dies upon the Rose Bishop's departure. Takes 3 turns to blend in. Flesh Bomb (5 Flesh and Blood): Tear off flesh to make explosive Flesh Bombs that explode into corrosive blood rain, dealing 3d Corrosive damage. Can be buried inside others' bodies and detonated. Flesh Blood Servants (15 Flesh and Blood): Create puppets with immense strength (ST 17), immune to spirit attacks. 15 HP. Self-destruct deals 5d damage in a 3 m radius. Flesh Blood Curse (0 Flesh and Blood): Curse a target if possessing their flesh (+2) and/or blood (+4). Use Ritualistic Magic to inflict 3d damage or for other rituals. Devouring (0 Flesh and Blood): Envelop a target, corrode their body from the inside, dealing 2d damage per turn. Flesh Softening (0 Flesh and Blood): Negate the next instance of physical damage except from knives and swords (which slash through). Disguise (0 Flesh and Blood): Modify appearance (muscularity, facial features) with practice. -3 to all reaction rolls while in disguise.

entries.name: Soul Assurer
entries.ability: Spiritual Vision (Passive – Reinforced): The Soul Assurer sees spiritual lifeforms at all times without activating Spirit Vision. Constant exposure grants +3 to Spiritual Perception rolls and makes it impossible for spirits to hide within line of sight. Requiem (2 SPI): Cause the target's Spirit Body to fall asleep. The target skips 2 turns (stimuli — being damaged, shaken, or a loud noise on their turn — wakes them immediately). Will-5 to resist; on success only halves Basic Move and Basic Speed for 1 turn and the target suffers -5 to Spiritual Intuition rolls for the same duration. On unwilling spirits, ghosts, and undead: Will-4 or forced into silent slumber. On willing allies: heal the Spirit Body, reducing Corruption by 1d3 points. Agitate (1 SPI): Agitate the target's Spirit Body, heightening their frustrations and destructive urges. The target must perform an offensive action this turn instead of fleeing or hesitating (Will-2 to resist). On a successful Divination Arts roll, one hidden psychological flaw or spiritual corruption in the target is revealed.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Dream Invasion: Range increased to 150 m (from 20 m quick / 100 m prepared). Midnight Poem: The Soul Assurer may manifest Midnight Poem effects through song instead of recitation. Nocturnality: The Soul Assurer requires only 2 hours of rest per day (down from 3–4). Night bonuses increase to +3 to all rolls (from +2).

entries.name: Spirit Guide
entries.ability: Language of the Dead: Speak a mystical language that urges a target's Spirit to leave its body, bypassing physical protection to directly target the Spirit Body. Spirit Calling (1 SPI): Urge the spirit to leave its body. The target rolls at -2 if dead, or +6 if alive. Commandeer Spirit (2 SPI): Command a spirit to obey your orders. The target rolls Will at -2 if dead, or +4 if alive. Spirit Enslavement (4 SPI): Enslave a spirit. The target rolls Will at +2 if dead, or +8 if alive. Language of the Dead does not work on higher Sequences. Marionettes are considered undead — roll Ritualistic Magic vs the Marionettist's Ritualistic Magic; +4 to the Marionettist if the marionette has a Spirit Worm core. Resurrection (1-4 SPI): Roll Ritualistic Magic. Turn corpses into Zombies or living skeletons. They have no will or consciousness. Spirit Swapping (2 SPI): Defend against Soul Body attacks by swapping your spirit with an undead under your command.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Spirit Channeling: Directly summon spirits from the Spirit World. Can command the deceased and natural spirits to fight. The undead commanded can have similar status to the Spirit Guide. Number of undead: up to thousands.

entries.name: Dawn Paladin
entries.ability: Giant (Free Action): The Dawn Paladin gains +20 cm in height permanently, and can temporarily gain an additional +20 cm at will. Light of Dawn (1 SPI): Fill an area of roughly 40-50 m with sacred Dawn Light. Inflicts 2d6 burning damage (HT/2 to halve) to Wraiths, Shadows, and Evil Spirits. Reduces corruption by 1d/2 for those in the area. Nullifies concealment effects and dispels illusions. Dawn Armor (2 SPI): Conjure a silver Armor of Dawn with 20 HP. Recovers 4 HP per turn by draining 1 FP (Free Action). Includes gauntlets, breastplate, and helmet. Sword of Dawn (1 SPI): Condense Dawn into a weapon. Each strike is imbued with Purification, dealing +2d burning damage to undead, wraiths, and ghosts. Hurricane of Light (3 SPI): The Dawn Paladin's most powerful attack. Insert the Sword of Dawn into the ground and shatter it, creating a hurricane of light dealing 5d+2 damage (+3d against Shadows and Corrupted entities, +3d against Evil and spirits — up to 8d total). Needs 2 minutes of rest before reuse. The Sword of Dawn cannot be condensed for 10 seconds after activation. The Dawn Paladin can control the hurricane's direction to a certain extent.

entries.name: Conspirer
entries.advantages: Acute Vision +2 to vision-based Perception rolls Acute Hearing +2 to hearing-based Perception rolls Acute Taste & Smell +2 to taste/smell-based Perception rolls Acute Touch +2 to touch-based Perception rolls
entries.ability: Conspiracy (2 SPI): The core of a Conspirer's arsenal — weave deceptions, misdirect attention, and create confusion among enemies. All enemies within 10 m must roll Will-2 or suffer -2 to all Perception, Observation, and skill rolls for 1d turns due to confusion and misdirection. Incitement (1 SPI): Incite certain thoughts or desires in someone's mind through conversation, such as consciously igniting the flames in their heart. Flame Transformation (2 SPI): Merge with fire weapons conjured from Pyrokinesis and travel to the destination where the fire weapon lands. Can take other people, but they take 1d damage from the flames. Initial range: 10 m (30 m when potion is digested).
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Pyrokinesis: Freely control flames within 15 m. Compress (1 SPI): Damage increases to 1d+3. Can multi-turn charge (5/10 bonus damage per turn spent charging, max 10). Conjure (1 SPI): Can now gain weapon skills with conjured weapons and parry with weapons of fire. Use the skill of the weapon the flame transforms into.

entries.name: Biologist
entries.ability: Cross-breeding (1 SPI): Create chimeras or cross-breeds between various animals, plants, and even objects — directly creating new species. Ordinary materials create unique species with directed abilities. Beyonder ingredients create more magical cross-breeds with unique properties. Before Sequence 4, cross-breeds lack a Soul. The result depends on player intent and GM discretion. Poison Creation (1 SPI): The Biologist's own body can produce highly potent toxin, accumulated and released through hair or other means. Releases poison dealing 1d+1 damage per turn for 1d turns in an area. Leaves the target poisoned for 1d/2 turns after leaving the area.
entries.reinforcedAbilities: Knowledge — Life: Deep understanding of living organisms. +6 to Hidden Lore (Living Organism).

entries.name: Potions Professor
entries.ability: Natural Sense of Smell (Passive): Differentiate people by their scent. Detect entities unable to hide their smell (e.g., wraiths). Strong odours impose -1 to all rolls. Discerning Spiritual Materials (Passive): Gain vast knowledge to discern spiritual materials for various concoctions. Can now treat terminal illnesses. Potion & Perfume Crafting: Create Potions and Perfumes with extraordinary effects. Roll Alchemy. Success margin determines longevity: 0-2 = 1 day, 3-5 = 3 days, 6-8 = 5 days, 9+ = 1 week, critical success = 2 weeks. Can drink up to 4 potions in battle before facing negative effects. Known Potions include: Solar Water Potion (Alchemy -1): Powerful against undead and vampires — 3d purification damage on contact. Dragon's Breath (Alchemy -1): Spit a fire breath dealing 3d burning (one-time use). Invisibility Potion (Alchemy -3): Become completely invisible. Lasts 1d×10 minutes. Anti-Smell Potion (Alchemy +0): Eliminates the user's smell and body odor. Anti-Dream Potion (Alchemy -2): Prevents Dream Pulling effects. Shadow Potion (Alchemy -4): Allows Shadow Movement at ×2 Base Move. Known Perfumes include: Animal-Friendly Perfume (Alchemy -1): Makes animals closer to the user — +5 to reaction rolls with animals. A true Potions Professor can research and invent new Potions and Perfumes (roll Inventor then Alchemy -4, with GM approval).

entries.name: Devil
entries.advantages: DR 2 Physical — skin mutated DR 2 Curses, Flames, Poison — highly resistant
entries.ability: Danger Premonition (Malice Perception): The Devil can sense the place of origin of danger and who it comes from. Requires 3 conditions: (1) the threat is fatal or life-threatening, (2) the source intends harm within a certain period and range, (3) the source acts on that intent. The premonition window ranges from a few minutes to 24 hours. The range spans from a few miles to an entire metropolitan area, depending on the individual Devil. Fearless: The Devil does not feel or experience fear. Automatically succeed on all Fright Checks. Devil Bloodline: Each Devil develops unique racial abilities upon advancement. Choose one of the following (or create a new one with GM approval): Shadow-Shifter: When forced into a life-threatening situation, the Devil can escape by leaving only a shadow behind. The Devil reappears at any shadow within 30 meters. Spirit Body (Rare): The Devil can freely switch between body and spirit form like a Wraith. Item Creation: The Devil can skin humans and perform complicated processes to form Beyonder items with usage or time limitations (GM's discretion). Skin Clothes: Anyone wearing a human skin crafted by the Devil can transform into the original person, disguising themselves completely. Devil Transformation (3 SPI): Transform into true Devil form — gigantify the body, sprout bat wings and goat horns. Gain +4 ST, +4 DX, +4 HT, and +2 DR. Spell restrictions are lessened in this form (e.g., launch 10–20 Sulfur Fireballs simultaneously instead of the usual 3). Language of Foulness: Devils speak demonic words originating from the Abyss, filled with Filth and Corruption. They can use the following: Slow (2 SPI): All targets within a 7–8 meter radius turn numb and slow or come to a halt. Reduces Base Speed and Basic Move by 5 for 2 turns. Can only be maintained for 2 seconds. Death (2 SPI): Dodged normally. Target may halve the effect with a HT roll. Inflicts 2d damage per turn for 2 turns. Corruption (3 SPI): An area-of-effect attack causing Abyss Corruption symptoms. Within a 5 meter radius, each target takes 1d damage and +1 CoR, creating black fog. The area persists for 1d turns. Sulfur Fireball (1 SPI per fireball): Launch pale blue Fireballs that explode and poison on contact. No more than 3 at a time. Each inflicts 1d+1 damage, plus poison for 1d-2 damage for 1d-2 turns. Sword of Lava (4 SPI): The Devil cannot move on the same turn. Deals 5d+3 damage. Can be dodged. Flame Cage (3 SPI): Within 10 meters, conjure a large Cage of Flames to block escape. Also blocks projectiles. Poisonous Flame Manipulation (1 SPI, Free Action): Manipulate Poisonous Flames within 30 meters — ignite materials, shape existing flames, or hurl a Poisonous Flame Jet at a target within 30 m (DX or Sleight of Hand to hit).

entries.name: Calamity Priest
entries.ability: Calamity Attraction (Passive): The Calamity Priest's body passively draws misfortune. At the start of each session (or once per in-game day), the GM rolls 3d6 to determine a calamity that will befall the Priest. The Priest may use their Foresight (Seq 9) to foresee the calamity 1 round in advance, allowing mitigation or avoidance. Active Attraction (2 SPI): Direct calamity at a target within 30 meters. Roll 3d6: 3–6 — Major: A genuine hazard — e.g., a carriage wheel flies off toward the target, a gas lamp explodes showering glass, a heavy crate falls from a pulley. GM determines damage (2d6–3d6 depending on environment). 7–14 — Moderate: Noticeable misfortune — e.g., a floorboard rots through underfoot (-2 to Move), a chandelier cord snaps (1d6, Dodge to halve), a chimney pot crashes beside them. 15–18 — Minor: Annoyance or fizzle — e.g., a pigeon swarm spooks their horse, a gust slams a window shut in their face (-1 to next roll). On 17–18 the calamity backfires on the Priest instead. The Priest cannot foresee or mitigate actively attracted calamities. +3 to the roll in hazard-rich areas (docks, factory, cliffside), -3 in sparse areas (empty field, open room). Psyche Storm (2 SPI): Assault the target's Spirit Body directly. Inflicts 1d-2 SPI damage (reducing the target's Spirituality pool) and applies -3 to all the target's rolls for the next 2 turns. At the end of each turn, the target may roll Will-3 — on success, the penalty ends early.

entries.name: Zombie
entries.advantages: DR 3 Physical — natural hardened body armor Regeneration (Very Fast) Recover 1 HP per second
entries.drawbacks: Sun Vulnerability Sun-domain abilities deal double damage and ignore DR; regeneration is suspended for 1 minute after a Sun-domain hit Zombie's Curse Every Full Moon, the Zombie endures great pain. If resisting, they lose the ability to fight — roll Will-2 for any action. Replaces the Lunatic's and Werewolf curses
entries.ability: Ice Control: The Zombie can control ice they are in physical contact with, gaining the following abilities: Contact-Freeze (Free Action, 1 SPI): Any physical attack that contacts a target's skin can freeze their body. On a successful Brawling/Boxing/Wrestling roll the Zombie freezes a body part — target's physical rolls at -1. Stacks with repeated hits. Ice Stun (3 SPI): Seal opponents in ice on physical contact. Target breaks free with ST-4. Ice Wall (X SPI): Freeze water into ice walls with 5 HP per SPI spent. Ice Floor (2 SPI): Create slippery ice layers. Targets must succeed Acrobatics or fall. The Zombie can spend 1 SPI to control the ice beneath their feet (Free Action). Ice Temperature (2 SPI): Lower air temperature, causing strong winds and snowflakes. Cold-sensitive targets roll Will or suffer -1 to all rolls in the zone. Decay, Rot & Withering: Wither Explosion (2 SPI): Make mid-range air explode into black wisps inducing Withering. Inflicts 1d6-1 damage for 1d/2 turns. Rotting Body Aura (Free Action, 1 SPI): Effuse a rotting aura — add 1d Decay damage to the next attack. Aura of Decay (1 SPI): Emit an aura that visibly withers surrounding vegetation. Sludge Creation (1 SPI): Create rotting sludge. Targets must roll ST, DX, or Acrobatics or have Base Move halved in the sludge area. Zombie Manipulation: Awaken the dead (1 SPI), cultivate puppets, control ghosts, and command them (0 SPI).
